chapters.title: TURNED AT THE 00
chapters.text: The bar reached 26,600, the gold 00 that starts the block, and closed back below it, 7.25 points clear.

chapters.title: BELOW THE 50
chapters.text: The bar closed below 26,550, the platinum 50 at the middle of the block. Next on the map below: 26,520, the 20.

chapters.title: BELOW THE 00
chapters.text: The bar closed below 26,500, the gold 00 that starts a new block. Next on the map below: 26,480, the 80.

chapters.title: TURNED AT THE 00
chapters.text: Back at 26,500, the gold 00 it closed below 12 bars earlier: the bar reaches it and closes back below it, 8.25 points clear.
